detail.longDescription: I'm trying to practice how to setup CI/CD in Azure. I've been following this tutorial by MS but I've got a bit confused at Step 9. I created the repo in Git but in Azure Overview it says there are two commits but when I go into Repos it says there's nothing there. I have the project locally and the URL is https://myname@dev.azure.com/myname/learn-playwright/_git/PlayWrightTest myname@dev.azure.com/myname/learn-playwright/_git/PlayWrightTest but on Azure it is https://myname@dev.azure.com/myname/learn-playwright/_git/learn-playwright I tried changing it by doing git remote add origin https://myname@dev.azure.com/myname/learn-playwright/_git/PlayWrightTest git push -u origin --all but I get the error remote origin already exists.
